name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.0.5
summary: Fix web management console navigation reactivity and finalize unified Firewall Rules management
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.0.5:
* **Web UI Stability Fix:** Resolved a JavaScript syntax parsing issue in the web management console that caused navigation tabs to become unresponsive.
* **Unified Firewall Rules Table:** Consolidated all system port rules and custom rules into a single unified table for complete visibility.
* **Full Rule Editing & Deletion:** Administrator has full authority to edit (protocol, action, port range, source CIDR, comment) or permanently delete any firewall rule, accommodating organization-specific blocking requirements even for native services.
* **Revert to Recommended Baseline:** 1-click "Revert to Default Template" button allows restoring the 20 standard Active Directory domain controller baseline ports at any time.
* **Live Rules Search & Filter:** Quick search box to filter firewall rules by port, protocol, source network, or service description in real time.
